changelog: NetchSuite Sign-In: New ZeroTrace login page with Continue with Google - sign in to sync your subscriptions as servers automatically
Optional Account: Use this device offline keeps ZeroTrace fully usable without signing in, and any Xray config from any provider still works exactly as before
Smart Sync: Only active subscriptions become servers; switching accounts replaces the previous account's servers and expired plans are removed. Manually added servers are never touched
Account View: Profile picture, name and LKR balance, opened from the round account button in the title bar
Secure Sessions: Sign-in tokens are kept in the OS credential vault (Windows Credential Manager / macOS Keychain), never in the app UI
Cleaner Server Cards: Full server names and a clear Synced badge, no more clogged text
